title: Profile inequality for restricted means
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\bbr$ take values in $[0,1]$. For $b\in\{0,1\}$, let $f_b(x)=f(x,b)$ and let $d(x)=\tfrac12(f_0(x)-f_1(x))$. If $U$ is the Gaussian profile that equals $\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$ and $0$ otherwise, then
\[
U(\mathbb E f)\le\frac{\sqrt{U(\mathbb E f_0)^2+(\mathbb E d)^2}+\sqrt{U(\mathbb E f_1)^2+(\mathbb E d)^2}}{2},
\]
where all expectations are uniform on the corresponding Boolean cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the Boolean cube of dimension $n+1$ to $\bbr$
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. Let $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to[0,1]$, put $f_b(x)=f(x,b)$ for $b\in\{0,1\}$, and set $d=(f_0-f_1)/2$. Then $\overline I(\mathbb E f)\le\bigl(\sqrt{\overline I(\mathbb E f_0)^2+(\mathbb E d)^2}+\sqrt{\overline I(\mathbb E f_1)^2+(\mathbb E d)^2}\bigr)/2$.
